android.desc:
AutoAlert: UPI Sound Alert is your ultimate payment companion, designed to give you peace of mind by instantly announcing your incoming UPI payments. Whether you're a shop owner, street vendor, or someone who wants to track transactions without constantly checking your phone, AutoAlert has you covered!

Never worry about missing a payment confirmation again. Our smart notification system reads payment notifications from popular apps like PhonePe, Google Pay (GPay), Paytm, BHIM, and more — then announces them out loud so you can stay focused on your customers and your work.

Key Features

🔊 Instant Audio Announcements
Get real-time voice alerts the moment a payment is credited to your account. No need to keep checking your screen!

🌐 Multiple Language Support
Listen to payment alerts in the language you are most comfortable with! 

AutoAlert now supports:
English ,
Hindi ,
Telugu ,
Tamil ,
Kannada ,
Malayalam ,
Marathi ,
Bengali ,
Gujarati ,
Punjabi

🎯 Smart App Filtering
Choose exactly which UPI apps you want to receive alerts for. AutoAlert intelligently filters irrelevant system notifications so you only hear what matters.

☁️ Auto Cloud Backup
Never lose your transaction history or settings. AutoAlert includes seamless automated Google Drive backup support, keeping your data safely stored in the cloud.

🔒 Privacy & Security First
We value your privacy above all else.

No External Servers: Your payment notification data never leaves your device.
100% Local Processing: All payment detection and voice announcements happen directly on your phone.

Optional Secure Backup: Data is uploaded only if you enable Google Drive backup, and it is stored directly in your personal Google Drive account.

Perfect For
1.Shopkeepers & Merchants
2.Street Vendors
3.Small Business Owners
4.Freelancers
5.Anyone receiving frequent UPI payments

How It Works
1.Select your preferred language.
2..Choose your preferred payment apps from the list.
3.Install AutoAlert and grant Notification Access.

Leave the rest to us! Hear instant voice alerts for every successful payment.

Download AutoAlert: UPI Sound Alert today and experience hassle-free payment tracking with smart multilingual voice alerts.
